PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE K SREENIVASA REDDY  CRIMINAL PETITION NO.24 OF 2025 Between:
Pitta Anand and Others ...PETITIONER/ACCUSED(S)
 AND The State Of Andhra ...RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT Pradesh Counsel for the Petitioner/accused(S):
1. T V S PRABHAKARA RAO
Counsel for the Respondent/complainant:
1. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR

The Court made the following ORDER:
This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, has been filed by the petitioners/A1 to A3, seeking anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No.170 of 2024 of Yelamanchili Town Police Station,
Anakapalli district.
2. A case has been registered against the petitioners herein and others for the offences punishable under Section 376 IPC, Section 5(1) read with 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Sections 9 and 10 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.
3. Heard. Perused the record.

sentences.text: A perusal of the material on record goes to show that marriage between petitioner No.1 herein/A1 and the de facto complainant took place on 19.06.2017.
It is alleged that the 1st petitioner herein/A1 had sexual intercourse with the de facto complainant without her consent on 22.06.2017.

Thereafter, in the year 2018, a case was registered against the petitioners herein in Crime No.68 of 2018 of Yelamanchili Town Police Station, for the offences punishable under Section 498-A read with 34 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

In connection with that, an agreement was entered into between the accused and the de facto complainant on 26.03.2023,
whereby they have settled their disputes amicably and it was agreed to pay an amount of Rs.12,00,000/- to the de facto complainant towards full alimony, out of which 2,00,000/- will be paid immediately after filing divorce petition and remaining amount will be paid after granting divorce.
By virtue of the same, the de facto complainant received an amount of Rs.2,00,000/-.

According to the learned counsel for the petitioners, having received the said amount, the de facto complainant has resorted in pressurizing the accused to part with more amounts apart from the agreed amount of Rs.12,00,000/-, when the accused refused to do so, the de facto complainant has resorted in filing the present complaint against the petitioners herein.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners herein/1 to A3 on the following conditions.
i) In the event of arrest of the petitioners herein/A1 to A3 in the aforesaid crime, they shall be enlarged on bail on their executing personal bonds for a sum of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand only) with two sureties of the like sum each to the satisfaction of the concerned Arresting Officer.

ii) Petitioners/A1 to A3 shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required, and they shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

iii) Petitioner No.1/A1 only shall appear before the Station House Officer concerned,
once in a week i.e., on every Saturday between 10.00 am and 01.00 pm, till filing of the charge sheet.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

K. SREENIVASA REDDY, J Dated:10.01.2025 Nsr HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K. SREENIVASA REDDY Criminal Petition No.24 of 2025 Dated:10.01.2025 Nsr Pitta Anand vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41859742/
